name: bench battery: mesh retrieval front-end in front of Claude (and a local model)
claim: librarian claim: the mesh front-end (B = Claude haiku + front-end, D = local + front-end) answers questions about this repository's private facts (numeric constants in src/*.rs) that the bare model (A, C) cannot, without hurting general skills. research_private gains by construction (the answer lives in the retrieval corpus); the test is whether the front-end finds it on unseen items and costs nothing elsewhere.

tune.role: today's 120 items, frozen; v1/v2 were designed on them -> tuning evidence only, descriptive bootstrap, no verdict

held.seed_slots: 31+i (item i of an axis, battery order)

item_score: mean correctness over K reps (strict ANSWER: parse / first fenced code block run in the docker sandbox; model_fail = 0; infra_fail never scored)
test: py/b1/gate.compare: paired t over items per (axis x world x split), Holm over the whole family (5 axes x 2 worlds x 2 splits = 20 when all four conds run)
keep_rule: KEEP iff research_private gains Holm-significantly (p_holm < .05, mean > tol) in the same world in BOTH HELD and CONF and no axis has a Holm-significant loss beyond tol in HELD or CONF; else REJECT-regress / REJECT-nogain
tost: +-delta equivalence reported for every test (evidence only; at n=30 it is expected to be inconclusive)
corpus_note: the retrieval corpus (DESIGN.md, RD-LOG.md, RD-LOG-B.md, src/*.rs) is live; its sha is pinned per run in the manifest (a change mid-run -> exit 2), a change between registration and run only warns; a changed or vanished private constant makes the battery stale (exit 2) and invalidates the registration
sandbox_scoring: host-side (bench/sandbox.py, B1 fix): only the candidate runs in the container, on the test inputs; the expected outputs never enter it. It prints its raw outputs once behind a random nonce; the host re-canonicalises and compares. Missing, duplicated or malformed output = wrong (model_fail-class, never infra). INFRA only when docker inspect shows the container was never created or never started; a started program owns its exit code (125/126/127 included).
analysis: python bench/analyze.py <tag> (HELD and CONF in the same tag)
run_once: HELD then CONF, each once; no re-runs to chase significance; infra_fail units are retried, model answers are never re-drawn
pins_note: machine-checked by run.py for HELD/CONF (exit 2 on mismatch): BENCH_CLAUDE_MODEL, BENCH_THINK (MAX_THINKING_TOKENS), BENCH_LOCAL_MODEL (when C/D run), sandbox.IMAGE, and sandbox_sha; analyze.py exits 2 when a HELD/CONF manifest prereg_sha differs from this file
